title: pp.dystort~
description: `pp.dystort~` provides dynamic distortion and saturation, using an internal envelope follower to keep the saturation level consistent across different input intensities. Its Squeeze, Squash, and Squish controls respectively apply tanh soft clipping, add odd harmonics, and add even harmonics; an optional power-of-two oversampling factor can be supplied as the creation argument for anti-aliasing.
